_note: Seed data for the Cortex submissions ticker. In production, this file is overwritten daily by a Snowflake → JSON export. See scripts/refresh-submissions.md.

submissions.title: Garden State
submissions.verdict: Garden State is a film that wants to be on the list. The list is films that don't have to want anything.

submissions.title: Drive
submissions.verdict: Drive is fine. The list already has Bullitt doing the job Drive wants to do, only with more conviction.

submissions.title: La La Land
submissions.verdict: La La Land would be on the list if it had ended fifteen minutes earlier. As is, Singin' in the Rain keeps the slot.

submissions.title: Inception
submissions.verdict: Critically respected, commercially loved, canonically inert. The Wizard of Oz is none of the first two and all of the third.

submissions.title: The Royal Tenenbaums
submissions.verdict: The Royal Tenenbaums is the film you put on for guests. The list is the films you put on alone.

submissions.title: Pulp Fiction
submissions.verdict: Pulp Fiction is already on Peter's list. Read it before pitching.

submissions.title: Whiplash
submissions.verdict: Two of these scenes are perfect. A film needs the whole runtime. The Treasure of the Sierra Madre has the whole runtime.

submissions.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
submissions.verdict: Considered against Vertigo. Cut. The list is what it is for a reason.

submissions.title: Mulholland Drive
submissions.verdict: Mulholland Drive is a director's flex. The list collects films, not auteurs.

submissions.title: Synecdoche, New York
submissions.verdict: Respectfully declined. Sunset Boulevard is what this submission was trying to be.

submissions.title: Children of Men
submissions.verdict: Children of Men is the wrong third act in a near-perfect film. The Deer Hunter stuck the landing.

submissions.title: The Master
submissions.verdict: The Master is a singles-band album of a film: one great hook, padded out.
